picks.excerpt: Figma's Data Science team assumed AI saves users time, but quantifying it required a new approach to research design. The post details the methodology behind measuring real time savings from Figma Make.
picks.rationale: First-party Figma research that puts an actual measured number on AI time savings — the methodology is reusable by any design org trying to justify AI tooling.

picks.excerpt: Developer Drin built a fully animated alien with no mesh at all — the whole creature is raymarched in Three.js with shader math, a reminder of how much visual craft lives outside asset pipelines.
picks.rationale: A fully animated creature with zero geometry — raymarched shader math in Three.js is a concrete, web-shippable alternative to asset-heavy 3D pipelines.

picks.excerpt: When building a highly interactive, tactile web experience, the architecture must serve the art direction. Alexey Kopytin explains the architectural rationale behind a digital stress-relief squeeze toy built with Lottie, DOM events and distance-based logic.
picks.rationale: Rare build write-up where architecture is chosen to serve art direction — the Lottie + DOM + distance-logic pattern is directly copyable for tactile interactions.

picks.excerpt: Apple and MLB will livestream games to Vision Pro in Apple Immersive starting August 28th — the first regular live immersive-video production pipeline at this scale.
picks.rationale: Dated, concrete milestone: live Apple Immersive production moves spatial video from one-off showcases to a repeatable broadcast pipeline.

picks.excerpt: ArtStation and Sketchfab have been sold, creating an integrated ecosystem spanning the whole creative process. Creative Bloq weighs what the merger means for digital artists' portfolios, licensing and AI exposure.
picks.rationale: Ownership change at the two platforms most designers park their portfolios and 3D assets on — licensing and AI-training exposure terms are now worth re-reading.
